title: Story Time at Graddy's Playhouse
seo_title: Story Time at Graddy's Playhouse in Springfield, MO
description: Story time at Graddy's Playhouse features books about home, read with Adam Graddy's real estate team, plus a visit to the new exhibit with hands-on STEM activities and pretend play spaces like a kitchen, living room, and backyard. It is a kids' event from the Discovery Center of Springfield and is held on the first Friday of each month at 10:30 AM. The next one is Friday, December 4, 2026 at 438 E St. Louis St. in Springfield, MO.
